title: Dungeon World Extra Sheets DEV
description:
🧪 Development Version

Dungeon World Extra Sheets expands Dungeon World with dedicated actor sheets for Hirelings, Animal Companions, Stashes, Merchants, and Mounts.

Purpose-built controls support skills, loyalty, inventory, purchases, carrying weight, and NPC moves. A Herculean Appetites helper also switches the Barbarian roll formula and marks additional complications directly in chat.

Includes English and German localization for Foundry VTT 12 and 13.
author: GreybeardGM
